items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Yes, I heard Bunk, Bunk had a nice band, yeah, a really nice band.

ctx.x: Did he play anything like Bunk? Well, a little bit.

A little bit like Bunk, you know what I mean, but he's mostly in the staff. You see, sometimes Bunk used to go up a little bit, you know what I mean? Yeah. But Buddy never did go up there too much. He just stayed right down in the staff. Yeah.
Well, now, can you tell me about Chris Kelly and what he sounded like?
